title: Asset cache with threaded loading for creature models, prop models and animation sets
player_outcome: A new creature type, town NPC, boss or piece of furniture appearing for the first time no longer freezes the game. Human NPC models are about 4 MB each; they now load in the background and show up a moment later.
design: Checked in code: CreatureVisual.Create, PropLibrary.Model and HumanAnimations.For call GD.Load<PackedScene> synchronously on first use (CreatureVisual.cs:25-44, PropLibrary.cs:47-67, HumanAnimations.cs:20-34). Human GLBs are about 4 MB each (for example lunatic_cultist 4.8 MB); the 29 animation sets total 22 MB. PropLibrary caches a null result forever.

Add game/Rendering/AssetCache.cs. `AssetState TryGet<T>(string resPath, out T?)` returns Ready, Pending or Missing. Request(path) calls ResourceLoader.LoadThreadedRequest(path, "", false). Pump(maxPerFrame = 4) moves finished loads (LoadThreadedGetStatus → LoadThreadedGet) into a strong-reference cache. LoadNow(path) is for the player avatar and menus. ResourceLoader.Exists results are cached; Missing is reported once.
Add game/Rendering/AssetPump.cs, a Node that calls Pump every frame (added by WorldLauncher; CharacterPreview uses LoadNow).
PropLibrary.Model: go through AssetCache. Pending returns null without caching the null or adding a Problem; Missing records one problem; add IsPending(path).
CreatureVisual.Create returns null while its scene or its HumanAnimations set is pending. HumanAnimations.For requests sets through AssetCache.

Callers: NpcRenderer and TownRenderer already retry null every frame. ProjectileRenderer shows its glow fallback until the model is ready. TileObjectRenderer keeps a chunk dirty while any group model is pending. PlayerAvatar and CharacterPreview use LoadNow.

Probes assets.pending and assets.loaded; timer assets.instantiate. Smoke scripts that check visuals straight after spawning (creatures.cmds, bosses.cmds, town.cmds) add `wait_until assets.pending == 0 300`.
files_modify: game/Entities/NpcRenderer.cs — pending handling in Acquire; single problem report
game/Testing/Scripts/creatures.cmds, bosses.cmds, town.cmds — wait for assets where visuals are asserted
tests: All smoke scripts pass; `props.problems == 0` still holds
perf.cmds: spawn 3 enemy types not seen before, then `assert perf.max.gd.npcs < 12`
verification: Rendering run: summoning a new boss or meeting a new human NPC shows no gd.npcs or assets entries above 16 ms in `perf spikes`
Visual: the creature appears within a few frames and animates correctly (humanoid sets attached)
risks: Behaviour of ResourceLoader.LoadThreadedRequest for .glb-imported scenes under headless CI: verify, and fall back to LoadNow when the headless display server is detected, if needed
Instantiating a 4 MB human still costs time on main; P1b-14 pre-warms pools
Touches NpcRenderer, ProjectileRenderer and TileObjectRenderer, which are also edited by P1b-10, P1b-14 and P1b-15: sequence
